name: Interpreting Dreams
overview: Scripture reveals that dreams can be a medium through which God communicates, as seen when God spoke to Jacob in visions of the night and promised to reveal Himself to prophets in dreams (Genesis 46:2; Numbers 12:6). The example of Joseph highlights that the interpretation of dreams belongs to God alone, underscoring His sovereignty over understanding hidden meanings (Genesis 40:8). While dreams may sometimes contain vanity or confusion, believers are admonished to maintain a reverent fear of God when discerning their significance (Ecclesiastes 5:7). Additionally, dreams can deeply affect the dreamer’s spirit, as demonstrated by Nebuchadnezzar’s troubling visions (Daniel 2:1), indicating their potential weight and divine purpose.
